segments.an4.164:1.3: Akkhamā paṭipadā, khamā paṭipadā, damā paṭipadā, samā paṭipadā.
segments.an4.164:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco [ekacco puggalo (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosantaṃ paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati.
segments.an4.164:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco akkosantaṃ na paccakkosati, rosantaṃ na paṭirosati, bhaṇḍantaṃ na paṭibhaṇḍati.
segments.an4.164:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī;
segments.an4.164:3.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati; rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ; cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.164:3.4: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā … ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā … jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā … kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā … manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī;
segments.an4.164:3.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati; rakkhati manindriyaṃ; manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.an4.164:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti sameti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti; uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ … pe … uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ … uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti sameti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.

lines: 164-166. Catutthe padhānakaraṇakāle sītādīni nakkhamati na sahatīti akkhamā.
“Uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāsetī”tiādinā (ma. ni.1.26; a. ni.4.14;6.58) nayena vitakkasamanaṃ samāti āha “akusalavitakkānaṃ vūpasamanapaṭipadā”ti.
Nidassanamattañcetaṃ, sabbesampi kilesānaṃ samanavasena pavattā paṭipadā samā.
